draft.author: Lance Zierlein
draft.strengthQuote: Thick and powerful with above-average foot quickness.
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.50, the 12th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 1st of 19 at DT. He lasted until pick 38, well after his grade rank (12th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Marcell Dareus. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: his final season (2020) ranked 2nd in sacks among the 19 DTs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the New England Patriots. 65 career games and 27 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 3 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (8 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: approximate value 8 (89th percentile), season snap share 65.3% (89th percentile), qb hits 11 (85th percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 interior lineman who played: 15 pressures against a median of 6, above the norm.
